item.title: “I am still playing”- reminds T20 World Cup 2026 ambassador Rohit Sharma; says ‘he’s getting used to sitting at home and watching'
item.description: Rohit Sharma, one of the only two players who have appeared in all nine editions of the ICC T20 World Cup, was named the tournament ambassador on Tuesday, November 25, 2025, by ICC chair Jay Shah. The groups and fixtures for the T20 World Cup 2026 were also unveiled, as the tournament will be played from February 7 to March 8, and India will be the defending champions, having won the previous edition in 2024, under the captaincy of Rohit Sharma. item.description: India T20I captain Suryakumar Yadav was present at the unveiling event of the ICC T20 World Cup 2026 fixtures in Mumbai on Tuesday, November 25, 2025. item.title: IND v SA 2025: WATCH – Virat Kohli arrives in Ranchi ahead of 1st ODI; gets greeted by former India teammates at airport
item.description: Indian batting stalwart Virat Kohli touched down in Ranchi on Wednesday (November 26) to prepare for the upcoming three-match ODI series against South Africa, slated to get underway on November 30 at the JSCA International Cricket Stadium.
